meta.name: ai-avatar-video
meta.description: Create AI avatar and talking head videos via inference.sh CLI. Recommended: P-Video-Avatar (fastest, cheapest, built-in TTS). Also: OmniHuman, Fabric, PixVerse. Audio: Inworld TTS-2 (100+ languages, emotion steering for characters), ElevenLabs, Kokoro. Capabilities: audio-driven avatars, text-to-avatar, lipsync videos, talking head generation, virtual presenters, UGC content. Use for: AI presenters, explainer videos, virtual influencers, dubbing, marketing videos, UGC ads, gaming avatars, NPC dialogue. Triggers: ai avatar, talking head, lipsync, avatar video, virtual presenter, ai spokesperson, audio driven video, heygen alternative, synthesia alternative, talking avatar, lip sync, video avatar, ai presenter, digital human, ugc, ugc video, ugc ad, avatar ugc

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AI生成虚拟主播和口型同步视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作AI虚拟人讲解或口型同步视频。
copy.tagline_en: Create AI avatar and talking head videos with lipsync.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce AI avatar explainer or lipsync videos.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过命令行生成 AI 虚拟人说话视频。它支持文本转虚拟人、音频驱动口型同步、多语言配音等，推荐使用 P-Video-Avatar 模型（内置语音合成）。
howto.when: 当用户提到“AI 虚拟人”、“口型同步”、“虚拟主播”等关键词，或要求制作虚拟人视频、替代 HeyGen/Synthesia 时触发。

say.text: 用这张照片生成一个虚拟人，说“欢迎来到我们的产品演示”。
say.note: 使用 P-Video-Avatar 模型，内置语音合成。

say.text: 把这段英文视频配音成中文。
say.note: 先转录再翻译，最后用 LatentSync 同步口型。

say.text: 生成三个不同声音的 UGC 风格虚拟人视频。
say.note: 批量调用 P-Video-Avatar，更换语音角色。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate AI avatar talking head videos via command line. It supports text-to-avatar, audio-driven lipsync, and multilingual dubbing. Recommended model: P-Video-Avatar (built-in TTS).
howto.when_en: Triggered when users mention keywords like "AI avatar", "talking head", "lipsync", "virtual presenter", or ask to create avatar videos as alternatives to HeyGen/Synthesia.

say_en.text: Generate an avatar from this photo saying "Welcome to our product demo."
Dub this English video into Chinese.
say_en.note: Transcribe, translate, then lipsync with LatentSync.

say_en.text: Create three UGC avatar videos with different voices.
say_en.note: Batch runs P-Video-Avatar with varied voice parameters.
